text:
Predicates:
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
FromAirport(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Susan FliesTo(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
¬(FromAirport(susan, lga) ∧ FromAirport(susan, lga)) ::: The departure and arrival cannot be the same airport.
John FromAirport(john, lga) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
FliesTo(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
